title: Oven-Roasted Mackerel Jjigae-Style with German Twist
description: A fusion dish that combines the flavors of German and Korean cuisines by incorporating the hearty, comforting flavors of a German-style roasted dish with the bold spices of a Korean jjigae.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil.
Place the mackerel fillets on the prepared baking sheet.
In a small bowl, mix together the German-style mustard, Korean chili flakes, and brown sugar.
Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the mackerel fillets.
Drizzle the sesame oil over the mackerel fillets.
Roast in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
While the mackerel is roasting, toast the German-style dark rye bread until crispy.
To serve, place a toasted slice of rye bread on a plate, top with a mackerel fillet, and garnish with chopped green onions.
